name: VitaOxiPad
author: theSame & santarl & saidsay-so
description: VitaOxiPad is a client-server application with the ability to connect your PS Vita to your PC via WiFi as if it were a DualShock 4 with support for all keys and triggers, accelerometer, gyroscope and touchpad. Windows and Linux are supported. ViGEmBus installation is required for Windows.
